manufacturer profile dimensions + texture/PBR + repeating module geometry

success_criteria: every target has canonical identity or explicit unresolved identity state
every avatar has verified scale before placement
render claims never exceed geometry/rights level
systems expose configuration constraints rather than only preview geometry
at least one placed avatar can travel from project scene to live offer/cart or RFQ route
